title: Artists in Cosmic Eye
description: Two women in sun hats and patterned dresses stand before easels painting a serene river landscape, while a massive swirling cosmic eye vortex dominates the sky above them, filled with stars, planets, and colorful nebulae.
prompt: Two women wearing sun hats and floral dresses stand at easels in a grassy field painting a peaceful river landscape. A gigantic swirling cosmic eye vortex filled with stars, colorful nebulae and floating orbs dominates the sky above them, blending reality and fantasy in a dreamlike scene.
